scope: To enrich biotinylated proteins, 250 μL of Streptavidin Magnetic Beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific, PI88817) were washed twice with RIPA buffer, incubated with clarified lysates containing ~1 mg protein for each sample with rotation for 1 h at room temperature, and further incubated overnight with rotation at 4°C.
